title: The 10 Best Hand Mixers Under $50
metaDescription: Our 10 picks for hand mixers under $50, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at hand mixers under $50 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: KitchenAid 5-Speed Ultra Power Hand Mixer
products.blurb: Key specs: 5-speed slide switch with locking positions, Wide-coverage spiral wire beaters, Built-in bowl rest.
strengths: Bowl rest and single-button eject are premium touches rare at this price
KitchenAid's track record for 8-12 year longevity
limitations: No dough hooks, whisk, or storage case included
Only 5 speeds versus 9-speed competitors in the same price band

products.name: Cuisinart HM-50 Power Advantage 5-Speed Hand Mixer
products.blurb: Key specs: 5-speed control, Two standard wire beaters, Cuisinart motor and beater design.
strengths: Handles standard baking tasks without the HM-90S price premium
limitations: No storage case, dough hooks, or whisk
Only 5 speeds, less granular than the 9-speed HM-90S
Not designed for sustained heavy-dough use

products.name: Hamilton Beach 6-Speed Electric Hand Mixer
products.blurb: Key specs: 6-speed control, Snap-on storage case, Standard wire beaters.
strengths: Handles all light to medium baking tasks reliably
limitations: Motor runs noticeably warm after 5 minutes of thick batter
Not designed for dense dough or extended heavy use
No dough hooks or whisk

products.name: Black+Decker Helix Performance Premium 5-Speed Hand Mixer
products.blurb: Key specs: 9-speed control with Turbo Boost button, 500W input power motor, Beaters, dough hooks, and whisk included.
strengths: Whisk is effective for whipped cream and egg whites
Dough hooks handle small pizza dough batches
9 speeds at a price where most rivals offer 5-6
limitations: Plastic-feel build quality versus KitchenAid or Cuisinart
Motor bogs sooner than the pricier 220W Cuisinart under thick loads
No storage case despite the multi-attachment kit
features: Beaters, dough hooks, and whisk included

products.name: Black+Decker MX3200B 6-Speed Hand Mixer
products.blurb: Key specs: 6-speed control, 250W motor, One dough hook included.
strengths: Includes a dough hook where the direct Hamilton Beach competitor does not
250W motor is adequate for everyday cake and cookie mixing
Valid alternative when the Hamilton Beach is out of stock
limitations: Slightly heavier than the Hamilton Beach at the same price
Only one dough hook, not a matched pair

products.name: Dash Smart Store Compact Hand Mixer
products.blurb: Key specs: Collapsible, compact storage design, Compact storage case, Standard wire beaters.
strengths: Smallest storage footprint of any mixer in this price range
Well suited to small kitchens, RVs, or drawer-limited households
Adequate performance for light to medium everyday tasks
limitations: Not rated for heavy dough or large batches
No dough hooks or whisk
Value is storage footprint, not raw mixing performance

products.name: Oster FPSTHM0152 5-Speed Hand Mixer
products.blurb: Key specs: 5-speed control, 1.8 lb body weight, Standard wire beaters.
strengths: Lightest mixer in this comparison at 1.8 pounds
Covers pancake batter, eggs, and boxed cake mix without issue
limitations: Not suitable for sustained use or stiff batter
Motor lacks headroom for cookie dough or dense batter
No dough hooks or whisk included

products.name: OXO On Digital Hand Mixer with Illuminating Headlight
products.blurb: Key specs: 9-speed digital control, LED headlight illuminating the mixing bowl, Digital speed display.
strengths: LED headlight is a genuinely useful touch for dim-kitchen baking
Competent 9-speed digital performance
Good fit for households already using OXO kitchen tools
limitations: No meaningful performance advantage over KitchenAid or Cuisinart at similar prices
Lowest rating count in this comparison (2,100)
No dough hooks or whisk included
features: LED headlight illuminating the mixing bowl

products.name: Cuisinart EvolutionX RHM-100 Cordless Hand Mixer
products.blurb: Key specs: Rechargeable cordless operation, Multi-speed digital control, Charging dock/base included.
strengths: Only cordless option in this price range, useful for counters far from an outlet
No cord to manage during mixing, easier maneuvering around the bowl
Charging dock doubles as a storage stand
limitations: Battery runtime limits sustained heavy mixing sessions
Motor torque is noticeably weaker than corded competitors at this price

products.name: Proctor Silex 62509PS 5-Speed Hand Mixer
products.blurb: Key specs: 5-speed control, Standard wire beaters, Lightweight, compact body.
strengths: Lowest-cost reliable option for households that bake only occasionally
Handles pancake batter, eggs, and boxed cake mix without issue
Simple controls make it easy for first-time bakers to operate
limitations: Not suitable for cookie dough or sustained heavy mixing
No dough hooks, whisk, or storage case
Motor lacks the headroom of name-brand mixers a tier up

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
